title: Assignment Tracker
description: A renderer-fired HTTP GET measurement tracker for one creative-to-package assignment, in addition to the creative's own trackers. Uses the pixel_tracker event vocabulary with image-pixel semantics; it is not a click destination, JavaScript include, or advertiser-site conversion pixel. The seller MUST fire every accepted tracker at its declared event or reject the assignment, including unrecognized custom events; silent no-op behavior is not permitted for assignment trackers.

event.description: Measurement event, with the same timing as pixel_tracker. An event the seller cannot fire on the assigned format MUST cause assignment rejection.

custom_event_name.description: Required when event is custom; MUST be absent otherwise. The seller must recognize and fire this event or reject the assignment.

url.description: Tracker URL template, preserved on readback. AdCP macros follow the creative tracker rules without declarations, including existing 3.x compatibility behavior. Creative asset macro_declarations do not transfer to this URL, and assignment tracker support does not promise resolution of any particular token.
